summary: iPower Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing a draw under its previously announced $30 million 6% original issue discount senior secured convertible note facility with an institutional investor. The company issued $3,000,000 principal of Series A notes for $2,820,000 net proceeds, following the investor's election of an additional optional closing. The notes carry a fixed conversion price of $3.156, equal to 120% of the September 15 Nasdaq closing price. This is a routine financing draw, not a special situation; watch dilution and overhang from the conversion feature.
